title: Money Supply for the fortnight ended on August 31, 2026
text: Money Supply for the fortnight ended on August 31, 2026. The Reserve Bank has today released data on Money Supply for the fortnight ended on August 31, 2026. Ajit Prasad            Deputy General Manager (Communications)     Press Release: 2026-2027/1104
